project1.title: NL2SQL Data Query Agent — Level 1 Entry Point
project1.desc:
The AI Data Query Agent is an entry-level Java AI Agent designed to help developers deeply understand the three core principles: LLM reasoning, Tool Calling, and task orchestration.

Key features:
1) Hand-written core logic with no dependencies on heavy frameworks like LangChain;
2) Pure Java backend implementation, ideal for Spring Boot developers;
3) Clean, well-commented code structured as an ideal learning path.

Core flow: natural language query → LLM intent understanding → automatic tool selection → SQL/API query execution → result formatting → task completion. Adaptable as an enterprise data assistant or automated reporting system.

project2.title: API Inspection Agent — Level 2 Automation
project2.desc:
The API Inspection Agent is a Java-native automated API quality monitoring tool built with pure backend engineering architecture, free of heavy AI framework dependencies.

Core capabilities:
1) Batch API calls: scheduled concurrent invocation for RESTful/gRPC endpoints;
2) Smart assertions: AI-generated assertion rules covering status codes, response structure, and field types;
3) Exception handling & retry: automatic retry with fallback for timeouts and service unavailability;
4) AI root cause analysis: automatic log and error analysis on inspection failures;
5) Automated reports & alerts: multi-channel notifications via DingTalk, Feishu, or email.

Ready to serve as infrastructure for small to mid-size team API quality assurance.

project3.title: Work Order Agent — Level 3 Business Integration
project3.desc:
The Work Order Agent is a Java-native intelligent ticket management system built on backend engineering principles without heavy AI frameworks.

Core pipeline:
1) Smart classification: LLM-based identification of ticket type (bug, feature, inquiry, incident);
2) Entity extraction: key entities from ticket text (system, module, version, user);
3) Auto-assignment: automatic routing based on classification and entities;
4) Knowledge base Q&A: RAG-powered retrieval of similar cases and auto-generated response suggestions;
5) Complex workflows: multi-level approvals and cross-team collaboration;
6) Root cause analysis & post-mortems: incident tickets automatically correlated with monitoring data.

Production-ready for internal enterprise deployment as an intelligent work order system.

project4.title: Code Review Agent — Level 4 Vertical Deep Dive
project4.desc:
The Code Review Agent is the most advanced project in the series — a Java-native implementation with no heavy AI framework dependencies that achieves a fully automated code review pipeline.

Review pipeline:
1) Code intake: Git repos, PR diffs, code snippets via multiple input methods;
2) Syntax & style checks: AST-based Java code style analysis (naming, formatting, comments);
3) Semantic review: LLM-driven logic analysis for potential bugs, logic holes, and missing boundary conditions;
4) RAG-enhanced analysis: context-aware review using internal coding standards and best practice docs;
5) Vulnerability detection: OWASP Top 10 scanning for SQL injection, XSS, sensitive data exposure;
6) Performance analysis: N+1 queries, memory leaks, improper collection usage;
7) Code optimization: design pattern-based refactoring suggestions;
8) Structured reports: Markdown/HTML/PDF multi-format report output.

Replaces traditional manual code review with standardized, intelligent, automated processes.

project5.title: Multi-Agent Collaboration System — Level 5 Architecture
project5.desc:
Java-native multi-agent collaboration platform. No LangChain/AutoGen dependencies — built on a strategy-pattern DispatchHub orchestrating multi-agent collaboration.

Core design:
1) DispatchHub orchestration center: unified task entry, handles decomposition→dispatch→collaborative execution→result aggregation. TaskDecomposer uses a hybrid strategy of rule-template priority matching (<100ms) + LLM real-time decomposition fallback, results validated by DAG cycle detection before strategy execution;
2) Seven collaboration strategies: PARALLEL / SERIAL / RELAY / MASTER_SLAVE / CONDITION / LOOP / APPROVAL implemented via CollaborationStrategy interface, each mode independently encapsulated with strategy decoupled from scheduling logic;
3) Pluggable Agent registration: BizAgent interface defines unified spec (agentCode + capability + execute), AgentRegistry provides centralized management, five built-in Agents (Ticket/Code Review/Document AI/Data Review/RAG Q&A) are interface implementations — adding new Agents requires zero changes to the scheduling core;
4) Security & multi-tenancy: Spring Security + JWT stateless auth, RBAC three-tier permissions (ADMIN/MANAGER/USER), MyBatis-Plus interceptor auto-injects tenant_id for data isolation;
5) Agent communication: Guava EventBus pub/sub decoupling, 7 event types covering the full task lifecycle, Agents never communicate directly — all messages routed through EventBus via the hub, global context shared via ConcurrentHashMap + ReentrantReadWriteLock;
6) LLM abstraction layer: LLMProvider interface unifies OpenAI/Anthropic/domestic models, LLMCache uses LRU caching for result reuse, TokenBudgetService tracks consumption per Agent with budget control;
7) Observability: traceId end-to-end tracing (MDC propagation), Micrometer + Prometheus collecting task/LLM/thread-pool/cache multi-dimensional metrics, tiered alerting rules (P1/P2).

Rule templates + LLM hybrid decomposition ensures reliability, seven strategy patterns cover simple to complex scenarios, EventBus event-driven + global context solves Agent data silos, LLM budget controlled per Agent for cost management, MyBatis-Plus interceptor provides transparent multi-tenant isolation.

project6.title: mindvaults — Local Private RAG Knowledge Base
project6.desc:
mindvaults is an open-source, privacy-first local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) knowledge base Q&A system built with Next.js 14 + FastAPI + PostgreSQL/pgvector, with zero third-party SaaS dependencies and fully offline operation — your data never leaves your environment.

Core Architecture:
1) Transparent RAG Pipeline: Intent recognition → vector retrieval → reranker → LLM generation, each step streamed in real-time via SSE progress events — no more black-box retrieval;
2) Cited Answers with Traceability: Every answer includes source documents, original text excerpts, and similarity scores; click citation numbers to jump to the original source, eliminating untraceable hallucinations;
3) Multi-Knowledge Base Isolation: Create multiple KBs with independent management of documents, chunks, sessions, and model configs; retrieval scoped to a single KB or global across all;
4) Multi-Format Document Parsing: Auto parsing and vectorization for PDF, Word, Markdown, and TXT files; one-click Obsidian vault import with automatic YAML frontmatter property extraction;
5) Pluggable Model Architecture: LLM and Embedding models independently configurable — DeepSeek / OpenAI / SiliconFlow / Ollama — switch providers without any code changes;
6) Dual Deployment Modes: Lightweight mode with 5 containers (cloud API) or full-stack with 6 containers (Ollama local inference); runs on anything from a Mac mini to cloud servers via Docker Compose one-click deploy;
7) Smart Routing & Knowledge Distillation: Three-tier fallback matching (centroid vector → LLM routing → user guidance) automatically selects the best KB per query; LLM extracts knowledge points from conversations and feeds them back after deduplication and review;
8) Concept Network & Content Health: Auto-builds domain concept networks during document ingestion with concept summaries injected into RAG context; Content Health Center provides near-duplicate detection, low-quality identification, staleness marking, orphan detection, and fragment cluster discovery with health scoring and one-click cleanup.

The project covers the complete lifecycle from document ingestion to knowledge accumulation, ready for production deployment as private enterprise knowledge base infrastructure.
